title: Pure Admin Template Manifest
description: Configuration manifest for Pure Admin project templates

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON schema for validation

id.description: Unique identifier for the template (lowercase, hyphens allowed). Matches the folder name.

technology.description: Technology group for wizard selection (e.g. svelte, react, elixir)

variant.description: Variant within the technology (e.g. sveltekit, spa, vite, nextjs)

description.description: Brief one-line description of the template

content.description: Markdown content for the template detail page on pureadmin.io

homepage.description: URL to the template's homepage or repository

scaffold.description: Commands to bootstrap the project before template files are applied

dependencies.description: npm packages to install after scaffold (key: package name, value: version)

placeholders.description: Template variables substituted at create time (__VAR__ syntax)

features.description: Optional feature blocks that can be enabled/disabled via CLI flags

default.description: Whether the feature is enabled by default

requires.description: Feature IDs that must be enabled when this feature is enabled

points.description: data-pa point IDs that belong to this feature

file.description: Path to page template file (relative to template root)

description.description: What kind of page this generates

instructions.description: Post-create instructions shown to the user (supports placeholders)

checksums.description: SHA-256 checksums of template files for change detection on upload

files.description: SHA-256 checksums of all files in template/, keyed by relative path

pages.description: SHA-256 checksums of page generator files, keyed by relative path

metadata.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON encoding of descriptive metadata (name, version, description, content, author, license, tags)

summary.description: SHA-256 over all individual checksums (files, pages, helper, metadata) — single value to detect any change
